cues.text: When Zargon notices you looking around for his soul crystal,
he tries to get to the pedestal before you - but it is already too late:
With two or three light-footed steps you reach the pedestal,
grab the jewel and lift it high over your head:
The stone pulsates dully in your hands, as if it were filled with a life of its own!
When he realizes that you have now gained power over him, Zargon resorts to begging:
he desperately begs you to spare him,
he offers you Mylgor's position as his governor in the small village -
yes, he even promises to turn you back into a human if you leave his crystal untouched:
He says there is a spring somewhere whose water could
heal you of your infection with the werewolf blood...
For a brief moment you let everything that has happened
pass before your mind's eye and think about what weighs more:
your fate - or that of the tormented and downtrodden villagers,
and it doesn't take you too long to reach a decision:
Without paying any more attention to Zargon's whimpering,
you smash the Soul Crystal to the ground with all your might,
where it shatters into a thousand pieces, each of which still reflects Zargon's portrait!
However, just as the crystal shatters, you hear Zargon screaming hysterically behind you!
Scared to death, you turn - to see Zargon in agony with a dense, dark gray cloud,
which must have been released by the breaking apart of the dark jewel,
where it must have waited many decades for this one moment!
Only Zargon's wildly flailing arms and legs still peek out of the dirty gray fog!...
Then - suddenly - the spook is over:
the cloud disappears as quickly as it appeared, and with it the evil sorcerer!
An oppressive silence fills the room as you let yourself slide down the wall,
exhausted: all that is left of Zargon is his crown and the royal scepter...
